content.value_statement: GPU effects in HyperFrames need deterministic timing and frame capture. This skill gives WebGPU, TypeGPU, and GSAP patterns for render-ready canvas compositions.
actual_capabilities: Defines the HyperFrames typegpu timing contract for hf-seek events.
Shows async WebGPU initialization with synchronous GSAP timeline registration.
Explains canvas alpha modes for full-frame rendering and transparent overlays.
Provides patterns for video textures, frosted blur passes, and WGSL full-screen triangles.
Documents deterministic rendering rules for frame-accurate export.
limitations: Does not supply a complete TypeGPU project scaffold.
Assumes the runtime already provides HyperFrames and GSAP.
WebGPU availability depends on browser and hardware support.
Video texture workflows may fail in headless Chrome during renders.

use_cases.title: Create GPU Motion Layers
use_cases.description: Designers can plan canvas overlays that react to HyperFrames seek events and remain frame accurate.

use_cases.title: Integrate WebGPU Pipelines
use_cases.description: Frontend engineers can connect WebGPU setup, GSAP timelines, and render callbacks without timing drift.

use_cases.title: Prepare Reliable Video Renders
use_cases.description: Video pipeline developers can apply deterministic render rules and flush GPU work before frame capture.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a GPU Layer
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a HyperFrames composition.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a WebGPU canvas layer for a HyperFrames composition. Include the timing contract, setup order, and fallback behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Wire Seek Rendering
prompt_templates.scenario: Connect render timing to HyperFrames events.
prompt_templates.prompt: Show how my TypeGPU render loop should respond to hf-seek time. Explain where GSAP timeline registration must happen.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Video Texture Effect
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a WebGPU liquid glass effect that samples a video texture. Include texture sizing, render caveats, and alpha mode guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Frame Determinism
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my HyperFrames WebGPU render plan for deterministic output. Find timing risks, capture risks, and browser compatibility issues.

output_examples.input: I need a WebGPU layer that follows the HyperFrames timeline.
output: Register GSAP timelines before awaited GPU setup.
Render only from the HyperFrames seek event time.
Submit GPU work and wait for completion before frame capture.

output_examples.input: Why are my exported GPU frames inconsistent?
output_examples.output: The likely causes are wall-clock animation time, requestAnimationFrame loops, or GPU work not being flushed before capture.

output_examples.input: How should I choose a canvas alpha mode?
output_examples.output: Use opaque mode when the GPU layer owns the frame. Use premultiplied mode for transparent overlays above HTML or video.

best_practices: Register GSAP timelines before awaited WebGPU setup.
Render from hf-seek time and avoid wall-clock animation sources.
Flush submitted GPU work before frame capture in render mode.
anti_patterns: Starting WebGPU initialization before registering timelines.
Driving animation time with performance.now or requestAnimationFrame.
Assuming video-backed WebGPU textures work identically in headless renderers.

faq.question: What does this skill help build?
faq.answer: It helps build deterministic TypeGPU and WebGPU canvas effects for HyperFrames compositions.

faq.question: Does it require WebGPU support?
faq.answer: Yes. The browser and hardware must support WebGPU, and the composition should handle unsupported environments.

faq.question: Why must GSAP timelines be registered synchronously?
faq.answer: The HyperFrames player reads timelines immediately during page load, before awaited WebGPU setup finishes.

faq.question: Can it use video as a GPU texture?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explains video metadata loading, native texture sizing, and headless render caveats.

faq.question: Does it generate complete shader code?
faq.answer: No. It provides patterns and small examples that users adapt to their own pipelines.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives structured guidance that Claude Code, Codex, and Claude can apply during implementation.
